# Grigorii Moskalev — Legal counsel and legal engineer

> Grigorii Moskalev is a legal counsel who builds AI tools for legal teams. 11 years practicing law, 3 years writing Python. Author of PII Shield (open-source MCP server that anonymizes documents before LLM analysis), memoforge (plugin for Claude Code and Cowork that drafts cited legal memos), Brand monitor (trademark-infringement scanner), and Plain (lightweight Markdown reader and editor for Windows and macOS). Based in Limassol, Cyprus.

## Pages

- [Home / About](https://gmoskalev.com/): Profile, about, projects, writing, contact.
- [PII Shield](https://gmoskalev.com/pii-shield): Product page — open-source MCP server for Claude Desktop that anonymizes documents locally before they reach the API. Covers pipeline, six skill modes, what it detects, install, compliance, MCP tools, stack.
- [memoforge](https://gmoskalev.com/legal-memo-writer): Product page — plugin for Claude Code and Cowork that turns a research-grade legal question into a cited .docx memorandum. Covers the pipeline, the memo and the decision brief, the specialists, the output bundle, Style Studio, install and the ten bundled legal databases, and limits.
- [Plain](https://gmoskalev.com/plain): Product page — lightweight Markdown reader and editor for Windows 11 and macOS. Covers the three views (read, edit, rich) plus split, supported Markdown, the folder-as-library model, byte-for-byte saving, shortcuts and settings, install steps for both systems, data locations, and limits.
- [Writing](https://gmoskalev.com/writing): Notes on legal-AI work — AI adoption in legal teams, the legal engineer role, memoforge, PII Shield, Plain, AI agents for legal research, brand monitoring. Originally posted on LinkedIn.

## Projects

- [PII Shield (GitHub)](https://github.com/gregmos/PII-Shield): Node.js MCP server. Anonymizes PDF, DOCX, TXT files locally with GLiNER NER + 17 jurisdiction-specific pattern recognizers (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, CY, EU). AES-GCM session export, multi-document session pooling, HITL review. MIT-licensed.
- [memoforge (GitHub)](https://github.com/gregmos/memoforge): Plugin for Claude Code and Cowork, v2. Turns a legal question into a cited .docx memo — intake, parallel statutory/case-law/doctrinal research, currency check, a frozen source pack with verifiable quotes, IRAC drafting, four reviewers, mediation, up to two revision rounds, and client-readiness polish. The pipeline runs in a tested Python CLI; memos in EN/DE/FR/ES/RU; bundles ten legal MCP servers (EU, UK, US, FR, CH, RU); /memoforge:brief makes a three-page decision brief; optional Style Studio house-style profiles. MIT-licensed.
- [Plain (GitHub)](https://github.com/gregmos/plain): Tauri 2 + Rust + React desktop app. Markdown reader and editor: read, edit, rich and split views; tables, task lists, footnotes, callouts, KaTeX, Mermaid, Shiki code, highlights, wikilinks; a folder as the library with file tree, quick open, full-text search, tags, backlinks, version history. Preserves line endings, encoding, BOM and untouched bytes; atomic writes; recovery drafts. Signed Windows exe and notarised macOS build. MIT license. No database, no account, no network, no telemetry.
- [Brand monitor (GitHub)](https://github.com/gregmos/Brand-monitor): Skill that scans App Store and the open web for trademark infringers and pirated APKs. Runs weekly. Single SKILL.md file — works on Claude or OpenClaw.
- [PII Shield v1.0.0 release](https://github.com/gregmos/PII-Shield/releases/tag/v1.0.0): Python + Presidio + spaCy original. Replaced by v2 Node.js rewrite. Kept downloadable for legacy installs.
